techniques.name: Core-reference workspace validation
techniques.description: Validate governed workspace directories by reading `core_reference.json` as the single source of truth and emitting deterministic results.
techniques.discovery_context: First component scaffold for the initialized inf.work workspace.

techniques.name: Core reference view extraction
techniques.description: Isolate `core_reference.json` loading and governed-directory extraction in a reusable component so validators and future checks share one deterministic source of truth.
techniques.discovery_context: Second component scaffold for validator reuse and CI-friendly testing.

techniques.name: Knowledge-base cross-reference validation
techniques.description: Validate that knowledge-base references to techniques and related component metadata stay internally consistent across JSON files.
techniques.discovery_context: Third component scaffold for semantic integrity checks across `knowledge_base/` and `ai_docs/`.

techniques.name: Registered validation rules
techniques.description: Model validators as registered rules with stable IDs, categories, severity levels, and standardized rule results so the governance product can scale consistently.
techniques.discovery_context: Rule-engine refactor that turned workspace and knowledge-base validators into the first registered rules.

techniques.name: Named rule profiles
techniques.description: Package stable governance rule bundles behind deterministic profile names so operators can run consistent subsets like CI, workspace-only, or KB-only without hand-curating rule ids.
techniques.discovery_context: Operator-control upgrade that layered named rule bundles on top of the registered rule engine.

techniques.name: Canonical status snapshot generation
techniques.description: Generate a structured system status snapshot and derive the human-facing markdown status report from that JSON-first source so status queries remain reproducible and compliant.
techniques.discovery_context: Governance artifact addition for canonical status reporting and reproducible markdown derivation.

techniques.name: Status artifact validation
techniques.description: Validate canonical status artifacts with registered status-domain rules so the structured snapshot and derived markdown remain synchronized with the current workspace state.
techniques.discovery_context: Self-governing extension that folded the status snapshot back into the validator framework via a dedicated status domain.

techniques.name: Deterministic resolver multi-hop traversal
techniques.description: Implement bounded explicit-path and inferred-route traversal over the governed resolver tile graph so status artifacts can report real multi-hop capability without placeholder debt.
techniques.discovery_context: Resolver capability closure after the user rejected trimming placeholders and required the system to implement real multi-hop behavior instead.

techniques.name: Deterministic profile surface promotion
techniques.description: Promote an existing named rule profile into operator shortcuts, CI workflow steps, and JSON-first governance reporting so the same deterministic rule bundle is runnable everywhere without drifting surfaces.
techniques.discovery_context: Resolver-only promotion after the dedicated runtime-integrity profile had already been added to the rule engine and needed first-class operator plus CI exposure.
